name: er-report-formatter
description: Deterministic docx-js rendering engine for the Agentic Equity Researcher FORMAT stage. Turns per-note content modules into institutional-style .docx. Engine (reportStyle.js) and CLI (build_reports.js) are the zero-judgment part; the markdown->content.js extraction is an LLM judgment task done by the report-writer agent per the equity-research-formatter skill.
